changelog: Brand Identity Overhaul: Multi-platform native graphical icon suite for Desktop (Windows ICO, macOS ICNS, Linux PNG), Android Adaptive Launcher, and Web PWA.
Global Dynamic P2P Sync: Duplex background sync listener directly in VaultContext, echo loop prevention, and Master Device reset selection.
Native Scheduled Notifications: High-importance reminders notification channel with customizable lead times (1-7 days before) on bills and goals.
Financial Calculators Suite: 6 institutional calculators (SIP, Step-Up, Lumpsum, SWP, FIRE Runway, Loan Schedule with full Amortization & Prepayments).
Reconciliation Diff Modal: Side-by-side stored vs ledger balance comparison with selective per-account reconciliation and demo data safety guard.
Lifelog Mobile Parity: Safe area insets, native status bar synchronization, hardware back button routing, tactile haptics, and AST Markdown Notes parser.
